profile.headline: Quality Assurance Software Engineer @ Microsoft | AI Evaluation, LLM Quality Systems & Test Automation | Computer Vision / OCR | TypeScript, C#/.NET, Python
profile.summary:
I spent a decade building systems that read things: handwriting, mail, damaged print codes, apple crate, bread tag, pill bottle, and bean can expiration dates. OCR and computer-vision systems that the U.S. Postal Inspection Service and every major mail-presort facility run millions of pieces a day on.
⠀
Now I build the systems that judge whether AI-generated content is actually good. At Microsoft I design the evaluation frameworks, automated testing workflows, and AI-assisted quality systems behind M365 and Copilot experiences.
⠀
⠀
🔬 COMPUTER VISION & AI/ML
• OCR systems deployed industry-wide, including USPIS and every major presort facility. Neural-network training for handwriting recognition, plus production OCR/CV model training on large image datasets. 
⠀
• Built WebGLGT, an ML groundtruthing platform with Google Vision AI that scaled labeling ~3x (annotators 70%+ faster) with no added headcount. Personal work in reinforcement learning (PPO/Stable-Baselines3) and LLM apps (Anthropic Claude SDK).
⠀
💻 SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT
• Full-stack across React, Vue, Next, Nuxt, TypeScript, C#/.NET, and Python. Production apps with Three.js/WebGL, backend services (Node.js, Express, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework), REST APIs and microservices, custom CRMs, automation suites, CLI tools, and WinForms desktop apps. 
⠀
• Strong on API design, databases, and real-time systems.
⠀
🏗️ INFRASTRUCTURE & COST OPTIMIZATION
• Saved $340K annually (84%) through infrastructure optimization. Two zero-downtime datacenter migrations in one year. Nutanix, VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, Cisco Nexus. Consolidated 40TB+ of legacy data into geo-redundant infrastructure; migrated an enterprise from Windows Server 2008 → 2025.
⠀
👥 LEADERSHIP & IMPACT
• Led 4 engineers supporting 6 OEM partners and hundreds of facilities; <24hr response, <1 week resolution. Eliminated $110K+ in outsourced IT. Technical liaison across engineering, sales, and customers. USPS CASS certification expert.
⠀
🛠️ TECH STACK
- Languages: TypeScript, C#/.NET, Python, JavaScript, SQL, PowerShell
- Frontend: React, Vue, Nuxt, Next.js, Three.js, WebGL, React Three Fiber, Tailwind
- Backend: Node.js, Express, ASP.NET Core, .NET 6/7/8, Entity Framework, REST, JWT, Firebase
- Data: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Firestore, MongoDB
- Cloud/Infra: AWS, Vultr, GCP, Hyper-V, VMware, Nutanix, Linux
- AI/ML: Computer Vision, OCR, Reinforcement Learning, LLMs (Claude SDK), PyTorch
⠀
Currently doing graduate CS coursework toward an ML/AI Master's.
⠀
📫 bpmiller32@outlook.com | 🔗 billmill.dev | 💻 github.com/bpmiller32

positions.title: Quality Assurance (QA) Software Engineer
positions.description: Designing the evaluation and quality systems behind AI-generated experiences across Microsoft 365 and Copilot.

positions.title: Technical Instructor
positions.description:
• Delivered hands-on technical instruction and lab training for Boeing manufacturing personnel at Boeing Everett, North Boeing Field, Boeing Renton. Certified across seven FAA-governed aerospace fabrication and inspection curricula.

• Built a Power Apps scheduling system for lab spot allocation and instructor load balancing, replacing a manual coordination process.

Certified to instruct:
- Fiber Optic Installation and Routing (TR009778)
- Fiber Optic Examination and Cleaning (TR014231)
- Fiber Optic Light Loss Testing (TR009914)

- Bond and Ground Resistance Measurement, Type I (6C64814)
- Crimping Terminals and Splices, Type 10 and Smaller (6C64784)
- BCA Solder Sleeve Assembly (6C64778)
- Electrical Inspection, Shield Terminations (6C64647)

positions.title: Systems & Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and shipped WebGLGT, a custom TypeScript/WebGL platform integrating Google Vision AI that scaled ML groundtruthing ~3x — made annotators 70%+ faster and eliminated the need for temporary staff

• Designed backend services, REST APIs, and SQL/Firestore data layers powering data prep, job orchestration, and evaluation feedback loops for downstream OCR/computer-vision models; owned schema design and resolved slow-query hot paths at scale

• Trained and iterated on production OCR/CV models using large image datasets (area- and line-scan cameras) across letters, flats, parcels, print codes, and routing marks for mail-sorting readers

• Built and maintained C#/.NET automation services for the postal-directory build pipeline — ASP.NET Core + EF Core, headless-browser crawlers, a raw-TCP protocol driving the OCR engine for build validation, and real-time SSE status streaming to a Vue dashboard

• Achieved $340K in annual cost savings (84% reduction) by eliminating Nutanix ($150K+), VMware ($80K+), and outsourced IT services ($110K+) while improving system reliability

• Architected and executed two complete datacenter migrations in 12 months with zero downtime for production systems serving hundreds of customers

• Consolidated 40TB+ across fragmented legacy systems into unified, geo-redundant NAS infrastructure with automated backup and offsite replication

• Redesigned enterprise network using Cisco Nexus switches and fiber, eliminating inherited multi-acquisition complexity and resolving chronic outages

• Led enterprise-wide OS modernization (Windows Server 2008 R2/Windows 7 → Server 2025/Windows 11 Pro) and an Active Directory forest upgrade (Server 2012 → 2025) with security hardening

• Led a cross-functional team of 4 engineers managing support, relations, and licensing for 6 OEM partners and hundreds of facilities; <24hr response, <1 week resolution; tier-3 support for enterprise OCR integrations

positions.title: Technical Services Manager
positions.description:
• Managed a cross-functional team of 6 technical consultants supporting 6 major OEM partners and hundreds of facilities for an industry-leading postal OCR solution deployed at USPIS and every major presort facility nationwide

• Supervised product releases, licensing operations, and deployment management for mission-critical OCR systems processing millions of mailpieces daily

• Continued development of new and existing products (dashboards and developer utilities), delivering 3 new products and 7 extension products across multiple technologies

• Oversaw USPS CASS cycle migrations, attending technical meetings and conferences at USPS headquarters, and ensured compliance with postal regulations and certification requirements across the portfolio

• Administered and optimized cloud infrastructure (AWS, Vultr) and the technical-operations budget (infrastructure, mobile products, code-signing certificates, vendor services) supporting hundreds of customer installations

• Directed training programs and daily stand-ups to manage team workload and escalations; maintained <24hr response and <1 week average resolution with industry-leading customer satisfaction

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered ArgosyDirMaker, a C#/.NET automation suite that cut monthly postal-directory compilation from manual hours to automated minutes, saving thousands in recurring labor

• Developed custom implementation patterns and extension products for the core OCR engine, transforming workflows into distinct product offerings

• Lead Electrical Engineer for the Print Code Verification project: designed circuits, integrated industrial cameras, and served as sales engineer during demonstrations — contributing to new business development

• Designed and built a custom CRM platform integrated with bug-tracking and wiki systems, eliminating data silos between QA, Dev, and Technical Services

• Architected the RAF website and internal knowledge-base wiki supporting 50+ users, reducing support-ticket resolution time

• Improved client OCR pattern recognition and read rates through custom OCR implementations; provided tier-3 technical consulting for enterprise clients

• Created internal tooling in C#, PowerShell, and scripting; authored API documentation, user manuals, and training materials

• Led infrastructure migrations (CRM, VPN, NAS, Subversion, VMs) and conducted integration site visits across CT, NY, NJ, AZ, OR, and DC

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description: Assisted LDOE's Chief Information Officer and Information Technology staff in evaluation of system resources and program development. Administered Windows and Mac systems and integrated databases. Installed routine network software and hardware and replacement of network and workstation components. Provided backup support to the Network Administrator and Application Owners/Administrators. Provided client support for 200+ employees with various and wide ranging technical issues daily.

positions.title: Networking Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description: Gained knowledge and proficiency in working with Cisco based systems and configuring VLANs. Installed, configured, and maintained server switches throughout the LSU campus and satellite properties. Provided diagnosis and support for LSU's various networks.

positions.title: Repair Technician
positions.description: Applied knowledge of circuits and game console architecture to perform various repair techniques on consoles ranging from the late 80's to present day. Mainly serviced current (at the time) generation systems Xbox 360, Ps3, Wii, Nintendo DS, and PSP handhelds. Also worked as a sales associate when needed.

positions.title: IT Support/Maintenance
positions.description: Maintained computer lab and performed various IT related work and maintenance for employee computers.

positions.description: Assisted Senators with various tasks during the legislative sessions and daily committee meetings. Organized and filed bills throughout the day.

projects.title: ArgosyDirMaker - Enterprise Automation Suite
projects.description: Full-stack enterprise application built with Vue.js and .NET Core designed to automate, catalog, compile, and distribute critical postal directories. Replaced week-long manual process with fully automated pipeline leveraging real-time monitoring, multi-stage processing, and intelligent file management. Microservices architecture with API-driven functions, Puppeteer automation, and real-time validation. Production deployment processing critical postal directories across multiple timelines.

projects.title: FireGame - RL Training Environment & WebGL Platformer
projects.description: Built custom WebGL game engine recreating classic Donkey Kong arcade game with advanced 3D graphics and physics simulation. Developed interactive reinforcement learning simulation environment for Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm using Stable-Baselines. Created training environment enabling AI agents to learn strategies and optimize gameplay through RL techniques. Passion project combining game development with cutting-edge machine learning.
